name: What is the difference between solid hardwood and engineered hardwood for kitchens?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between solid hardwood and engineered hardwood for kitchens?

acceptedAnswer.text: Solid hardwood is made from a single piece of wood, offering a classic look and the ability to be refinished multiple times. Engineered hardwood, however, has a core of plywood or HDF with a real wood veneer on top, making it more stable and resistant to moisture fluctuations, which is beneficial in a kitchen environment. While solid hardwood can be more susceptible to warping from spills, engineered hardwood offers better dimensional stability in humid conditions.
acceptedAnswer.description: Solid hardwood is one piece of wood, while engineered hardwood has a layered core, offering better moisture resistance for kitchens.
